summary: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd., a NASDAQ-listed Korean-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing via Exhibit 99.1 a $10,000 charitable donation to the ASPCA. CEO In Keuk Kim and CFO Joseph A. Sigrist are quoted; no board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics appear. A play-to-enter giveaway, the Huggable Hounds event, is scheduled for September 13, 2026. This is a routine corporate social-responsibility press release, not a special situation; there are no securities, ownership, regulatory-clock, or deal terms to track and no risk-arb angle.
